message: You know how some languages sound. But how do they look?
Well let's draw them depending on their properties.
Chinese languages have isolating morphology, so let's have their ears isolated
But Japanese or Korean are agglutinative, so let's glue those ears together
Turkish has the aspect of evidentiality, so let's give it big eyes
Hawaiian has 13 sounds, that's how much teeth it has
Unlike Khoekhoe with no less that 115 sounds
Georgian can put up to 6 consonants in a cluster, so its teeth will reflect that
Hungarian has amazing 18 declension cases, so it deserves a corresponding moustache
While Fula with 25 noun classes needs a proper hairstyle
Vietnamese is tonal, which you can recognize by stripes on its tongue
While Swedish has a pitch accent and therefore another kind of stripes
Explore that, and hear how all these languages sound.
...or at least how some front-end developer guy thinks that they sound
